description: This file defines classes and functions for managing conversation contexts, message handling, and auxiliary functionalities for integrating with OpenAI's language models within the Pipecat project. It includes the main context class 'OpenAILLMContext', custom JSON encoding, and related data structures.

classes.name: CustomEncoder
classes.description: Custom JSON encoder that handles io.BytesIO objects for improved logging readability.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContext
classes.description: Manages conversation state, message history, tools, and multimedia content for OpenAI API integration, with support for message manipulation, serialization, and logging.

classes.name: OpenAILLMContextFrame
classes.description: A data class representing a frame that contains an OpenAI-specific context, meant for use within a larger frame processing system. Deprecated in favor of more universal context classes.
